cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on the promotion. I'll show you how to chair the meeting; it's lovely they're giving you room to learn.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've chaired meetings for two years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this will be a wonderful chance to chair one on time. Start with decisions, please, not the full history.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could send me your agenda. That would help more than this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Delighted. Keep my timings on it; they're the part that works. How reassuring that your first meeting in charge can begin with something proven.

reason: B's useful request lets A offer help as praise while competitive resentment leaks through claimed unique competence.
